(19 September 2026) |attendance = 146,097 |average attendance = 3,320 |prevseason = [[2025–26 Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina|2025–26]] |nextseason = ''2027–28'' |updated = 11 October 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina''' (known as the '''Wwin League''' for sponsorship reasons) is the 27th season of the [[Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina]], the highest [[Association football|football]] [[Bosnia and Herzegovina football league system|league]] of [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The season began on 7 August 2026 and will end on 30 May 2027, with a winter break between mid December 2026 and early February 2027. [[FK Borac Banja Luka|Borac Banja Luka]] are the defending champions, having won their fourth Premier League title in the [[2025–26 Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina|previous season]]. ==Teams== Ten teams are contesting in the league – the top eight teams from the previous season and one promoted from each of the second-level leagues. The promoted teams are [[NK Čelik Zenica|Čelik Zenica]], who returned to the top flight after an absence of six years, and [[FK BSK Banja Luka|BSK Banja Luka]], who earned promotion for the first time in their history.{{cite web|url=https://www.klix.ba/sport/nogomet/bsk-banja-luka-uz-celik-ulazi-u-najvisi-rang-bh-nogometa-dobili-su-licencu-za-nastup/260702201|title=BSK Banja Luka uz Čelik ulazi u najviši rang bh. nogometa, dobili su licencu za nastup|date=2 July 2026|access-date=6 July 2026|language=bs|author=D. P.|publisher=Klix.ba}} They replaced [[HŠK Posušje|Posušje]] and [[FK Rudar Prijedor|Rudar Prijedor]], who were relegated after respective spells of five years and one year in the top flight.{{cite web|url=https://sportsport.ba/fudbal/borac-posusje-sloga-radnik-wwin-liga-bih/522811|title=Slavlje u Doboju, Posušje nakon poraza od Borca ispalo iz WWin lige BiH!|date=26 May 2026|access-date=6 July 2026|language=bs|author=Esmer Oštraković|website=sportsport.ba}} ===Stadiums and locations=== {{Location map+|Bosnia and Herzegovina|float=right |width=330 |caption=Locations of the 2026–27 Premier League of BiH clubs|places= {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=44.775970 |long=17.199611 |label=[[FK Borac Banja Luka|Borac]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=44.772 |long=17.191 |label=[[FK BSK Banja Luka|BSK]]|position=right}} {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=44.205727 |long=17.907178 |label=[[NK Čelik Zenica|Čelik]]|position=right}} {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=44.754353 |long=19.225034 |label=[[FK Radnik Bijeljina|Radnik]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=43.873697 |long=18.408633 |label=[[FK Sarajevo|Sarajevo]]|position=top}} {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=44.732269 |long=18.093903 |label=[[FK Sloga Doboj|Sloga]]|position=top}} {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=43.366667 |long=17.583333 |label=[[NK Široki Brijeg|Široki Brijeg]]|position=left}} {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=43.333333 |long=17.8 |label=[[FK Velež Mostar|Velež]]|position=top}} {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=43.345560 |long=17.795308 |label=[[HŠK Zrinjski Mostar|Zrinjski]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Bosnia and Herzegovina|lat=43.846521 |long=18.387336 |label=[[FK Željezničar Sarajevo|Željezničar]]|position=right}} }} :'' Note: Table lists in alphabetical order.'' {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
